## 🧠 AIML / Dev

- [ ]  **Day 8 · Fri 30 Oct: HTTP and REST**

- [ ]  **Day 9 · Sat 31 Oct: async and await**
    - 📺 **Learn:** YT: search "Python asyncio tutorial" (ArjanCodes or mCoding)
    - 🛠️ **Do:** Fetch 20 URLs one by one, then concurrently with httpx.AsyncClient; compare the time
- [ ]  **Day 10 · Sun 01 Nov: Pydantic**
    - 📺 **Learn:** Docs: Pydantic models and settings. YT: search "Pydantic v2 tutorial"
    - 🛠️ **Do:** Model a job posting in Pydantic, feed it bad data, load settings from a .env file
- [ ]  **Day 11 · Mon 02 Nov: Git and GitHub workflow**
    - 📺 **Learn:** YT: freeCodeCamp, Git and GitHub crash course
    - 🛠️ **Do:** In a practice repo: create a merge conflict, resolve it, open a pull request, rebase a branch
- [ ]  **Day 12 · Tue 03 Nov: (Skim, you know most of this) Docker basics**
    - 📺 **Learn:** YT: TechWorld with Nana, Docker crash course
    - 🛠️ **Do:** Containerize your Day 7 CLI tool and run it with a mounted volume
- [ ]  **Day 13 · Wed 04 Nov: (Skim, you know most of this) PostgreSQL and SQL**

    - 🛠️ **Do:** Run Postgres in Docker; create tables, write joins, add an index, compare EXPLAIN before and after
